evidence.title: GitHub - NikunjSonigara/create-react-shadcn-kit: Create a React (Vite) app with shadcn/ui, Tailwind v4, Redux Toolkit, and Husky pre-integrated

name: create-react-shadcn-kit
summary: CLI that scaffolds a Vite + React app with shadcn/ui, Tailwind v4, optional Redux or Zustand and Husky.
description: An interactive CLI that scaffolds a production-ready React (Vite) app in one command: TypeScript or JavaScript, Tailwind CSS v4 via @tailwindcss/vite, @/ path aliases in vite.config and tsconfig, shadcn/ui init with your chosen components, a Redux Toolkit or Zustand store, and optional Husky + lint-staged + Prettier pre-commit hooks. Node.js 22+ required.
contains: interactive CLI published as create-react-shadcn-kit on npm
scaffolds Vite + React (TS or JS) with Tailwind CSS v4 and @/ path aliases
runs shadcn init and pre-installs the components you select
state: Redux Toolkit (default) or Zustand with a sample store wired in
optional Husky + lint-staged + Prettier pre-commit hook
